summary: Tested full bakery app (backend + frontend). 12/12 backend pytest pass. Storefront catalogue, category filter (Bread=3), order modal/quantity stepper, success screen all work. Admin login (admin@bakery.com/admin123) succeeds, products tab shows 9 seeded products, Orders tab lists both test orders created via storefront and direct API.

minor.issue: When admin user lookup fails returns 401 'Admin not found' which is fine; no 403 distinction. Low impact.
Empty items rejected via Pydantic 422 (test accepts both 400/422), but explicit 400 path in code is unreachable due to model_validate ordering. Minor.

issues: Order cards lack data-testid like order-row-{id} which makes targeted UI testing harder, but functionality works.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="order-row-{id}" to admin order cards for future automated tests.
Optional: silence React Router v7 future-flag warnings (cosmetic console noise).
Optional: cookie set with samesite=none + secure=true is fine over HTTPS preview but won't work locally over http; document for local dev.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: cookie samesite='none' requires secure=true (correct here). Good.
server.py: seed_admin idempotent and updates password if changed — matches playbook.
server.py: bcrypt hash format starts with $2b$ (verified via login test).
CORS allow_credentials=True with explicit origins (FRONTEND_URL + localhost) — correct.
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails). Not blocking but recommended.
Order creation has no rate limiting — public endpoint could be spammed.
seed_data_creation: 9 products auto-seeded by backend; created 2 TEST orders + 1 TEST_ product (then deleted) via tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend testids: order form fields use order-name/order-phone/order-address/order-notes/order-submit-btn. Category filters use category-{lowercase}. Admin product rows use product-row-{id}. Admin order rows do NOT have testid. Cookie httpOnly set on login plus token in body for Bearer auth.
